department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The ECE department requires GRE scores, but the requirement is waived with an undergraduate GPA of 3.5 from S&T electrical or computer engineering courses.
gre_general.quote: The ECE department requires ETS-reported GRE scores and recommends the following scores | This GRE requirement may be waived if the applicant has an undergraduate GPA of 3.5

gre_subject.value: ECE has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding statement for the PhD.

entry_route.value: PhD applicants are expected to have a graduate GPA of 3.5; exceptional applicants can enter directly after the bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Students seeking admission to the Ph.D. program are expected to meet all of the above recommendations and have a graduate GPA of 3.5 or better | Exceptional applicants may apply directly to the Ph.D. program after completing the baccalaureate degree

also.quote: Exceptional applicants may apply directly to the Ph.D. program after completing the baccalaureate degree.

notes: Covers electrical engineering and computer engineering PhDs. Department PhD pages on the mst.edu subdomains could not be reached (TLS verification failure through the proxy); this record uses the graduate catalog only.
